settlement_source: United States Congress (congress.gov/Senate records) for party of first-sworn Senator, TX seat, term starting 2027; accelerated path via >=4 of 8 Designated Media Sources (NYT, AP, DDHQ, CNN, Fox, NBC, CBS, ABC) with none contradicting
settlement_variable: Party of the first person who presents certificate of election and is sworn in for the TX Senate term beginning 2027 (replacement's party if vacancy before seating)
tie_handling: No tie clause; independents specified by individual; party switch between election and swearing-in resolves by party on election day
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading = expiration = first 10:00 AM ET after swearing-in or 1 year after popular vote, whichever sooner; or earlier on accelerated media-call resolution (can_close_early=1, settlement_timer 1800s). Listed close_time 2027-11-03 is a placeholder upper bound. Settlement no later than day after expiration unless under review.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Accelerated resolution once >=4 of 8 media sources call and none contradict
Exchange may replace a media source at sole discretion
Kalshi may open Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(c)/7.1) at sole discretion
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'win the Senate race' vs rules: resolves on who is SWORN IN, not who wins the election; recount/contest/vacancy can change answer
Market title says 'Democratics' (typo); yes_sub_title names a candidate (Paxton/Talarico) but rules are party-based
Early determination can pay on media calls before certification
toxicity_flags: Settles on media-call consensus on election night; informed flow (decision-desk staff, count observers) prohibited but unenforceable intraday
Election-night jump risk: gaps to 0/1 as calls land; adverse selection for resting quotes
notes: TX Class II race, election Nov 3 2026. Avoid resting quotes around poll close/count windows. Terms read from SENATEPARTY.pdf.
